title: Signal lab
tagline: Crack ciphers, tap Morse and punch cards like it’s 1970.
teaser: A lab of old codes: shift ciphers, Morse, punch cards, paper tape and giant banners. Decode, encode and play with each one.

inspiredBy.program: caesar, rot13, morse, bcd, ppt, banner

manPage.synopsis: signal — encode and decode messages with classic ciphers and codes.
manPage.description: Six BSD programs in one lab: caesar and rot13 for shift ciphers, morse, bcd and ppt for antique codes, and Mark Horton’s banner for big letters.

howToPlay: Pick a code: shift ciphers, Morse, punch cards or banners.
Encode your own messages or crack the ones you are given.
Learn how each old code works as you play.
